name: off-by-one in pagination
about: An off-by-one in a pagination slice returns one extra item per page.
diff:
diff --git a/pager.py b/pager.py
--- a/pager.py
+++ b/pager.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def page_items(items, page, per_page):
     start = page * per_page
-    end = start + per_page
+    end = start + per_page + 1
     return items[start:end]

head_sources.pager.py:
def page_items(items, page, per_page):
    start = page * per_page
    end = start + per_page + 1
    return items[start:end]

base_sources.pager.py:
def page_items(items, page, per_page):
    start = page * per_page
    end = start + per_page
    return items[start:end]

findings.title: off-by-one: the page returns one extra item

skeptic.reason: the slice end exceeds the page size
